scope: Live private Photon room: rendered Editor host and two independent Realtime peers. Verifies transport, sender ownership, shared progress, late join and host handoff. Remote rendered UI and physical Android are not verified.

checks.name: Independent clients share an invisible private room
Native player retains local control ownership
Remote replica cannot consume host input
T3 guest Book starts the authenticated shared six-minute clock
Late join restores actual placed words, current stage and exact deadline
T3 reserves the team topic from other guest Book starts
Correct guest premises open the shared crystal stage without resetting time
Wrong crystal charges its authenticated sender once and retains the altar
Replayed T3 submission cannot repeat the penalty
Untrusted guest snapshot cannot forge inference completion
Live master handoff preserves solved premises, current crystal and deadline
Crystal timeout preserves the stage and adds one Book-activator mistake
Teammate retries directly at the saved crystal stage
Teammate finishes the restored challenge and receives its original conclusion
Guest cannot steal a word tablet held by another teammate
Departure returns carried words while preserving the reservation and mistake identity
Premise timeout keeps solved challenges and current words, attributing the current activator
Only the captured player loses inference interaction authority
Captured guest cannot edit or release T3
Photon premise stage 2 solved by the remaining teammate
Photon Rule Crystal stage 2 shares its conclusion
Photon premise stage 3 solved by the remaining teammate
Photon Rule Crystal stage 3 shares its conclusion
Photon premise stage 4 solved by the remaining teammate
Photon Rule Crystal stage 4 shares its conclusion
Photon premise stage 5 solved by the remaining teammate
Photon Rule Crystal stage 5 shares its conclusion
All five live T3 challenges complete, freeze time and release the next topic
